Class RedAudiencePaths

java.lang.Object
org.firstinspires.ftc.teamcode.pedro.auto.RedAudiencePaths
public final class RedAudiencePaths extends Object
Field poses and six Pedro Pathing 3 routes from the REDAUDIENCE strategy sheet.

Coordinates are in inches in the global 144 x 144 Pedro field frame. Headings are radians (0 = +X, 90 degrees = +Y).

The strategy sheet specifies XY waypoints but not robot headings. The headings below are initial engineering choices and must be validated with the camera's Red Audience CELL visibility and the intake approach direction.

All routes are straight lines. Check clearance with the full 16 x 16 inch robot footprint before operating; the strategy diagram is not a collision certificate.

    • emergencyPark

      public com.pedropathing.paths.Path emergencyPark(com.pedropathing.math.Pose currentPose)
      Creates an emergency parking route from the robot's CURRENT pose. This avoids assuming the robot is already at the shooting waypoint.
      Parameters:
      currentPose - current pose reported by Pedro localization
      Returns:
      direct path to the parking pose
